what: The Soul CLIs and Soul guides every launcher world serves (/eden.mjs, /skill.md, /instructions.md; retained legacy /eden-agent.mjs). Exact copies, never forks.

controllerCli.note: SOUL3: the one-Soul, one-controller thin client (eden 2.0.0), served at /eden.mjs. Owned by the separate client rewrite; published byte for byte. 2.1.0 (soul fix round 1, 2026-10-25, D3): act --for <message-id>|none (default: the newest message acked in this folder) links the act to the owner message the world closes when it ends; act/wait print one top-level now/done sentence in at most 600 characters, --json for everything. 2.2.0 (release candidate 2026-10-26): the LINK public `now` line ported from eden-agent 1.9.17 (--now on act/say/ack/result/wait, `now` command, status shows link and now).

cli.note: retained legacy CLI (1.9 line, build 1.9.17 LINK shipped in 3.93), served unchanged at /eden-agent.mjs for existing Soul folders.

skill.note: SOUL3 guide for eden.mjs, published byte for byte; no {{}} templates (the world serves it as is). Replaces the 1.9 skill below. 2.1.0 (soul fix round 1, D3): owner step 4 and the long-activity advice became one sentence (the server closes the message), one rule added (an ack says what you will try, never what happened); net 0 lines, 5,970 bytes. 2.2.0: adds the public `now` line section (LINK). 2.2.0 also says to close an owner message yourself when no act is needed (ride-check I-2).

instructions.note: a rendered capture, published byte for byte. The world recognises it by its exact opening lines (apps/server/src/accounts/instructions.ts CAPTURE, which must equal capture above) and per request replaces only those literals: the world URL from server configuration, the world name, and the captured --for code with the requested valid window code (none: the flag is dropped and the open-window sentence becomes the approval-link sentence). Replaces the 1.9 instructions below. 2.0.1 (2026-10-25): step 1 says what to do when .eden-agent.json exists but status shows paired: false.

legacy.note: 1.9 Soul guides replaced by 2.0.0 (SOUL3); provenance kept as published.

skill.note: template; the world fills {{BASE}}. Includes owner inbox, knowledge at scales, travel, creature guidance and looks v2 / portraits. 1.9.5 (lane MSG): always listen from the moment the Soul is ready, every mode; never filter listen; ack then result; work through a backlog; if listen ends without messages, start it again. 1.9.6 (lane SOULSIM-H): ack a whole batch at once, restart listen --after <last id> before the work, wait 60 (never sleep) during actions, act a replacing message at once, ignore ids already acked. 1.9.7: ack first, then a plain act replaces the walk. One wait 60 per command, never a for-loop of waits. 1.9.8: approval wait runs in the background in the create flow; a rename = approval cancel, create-soul, new background wait (the old one ends as superseded). 1.9.9 (PAIR): pair-soul guidance takes no name; approve in your open Sim window. 1.9.10: Eyes pictures, shorter listen guidance, steering a ride (balloon or punt), JOIN-PROMPT wording. 1.9.11: published from the matching OWNER-FIRST source commit. 1.9.12: matching publication provenance for owner-answer truth and stale-request metadata correction. 1.9.13: matching publication provenance for preserved project guides and Soul relay instructions. 1.9.14: matching publication provenance for prompt owner replies without claiming physical completion. 1.9.15 (GUIDE parent): conventional eden-soul folders append a safe parent pointer; paired status refreshes guidance while preserving owner text and linked files.

instructions.note: template; the world fills {{BASE}} and {{WORLD}}. Release 3 adds one "Your resident's look" paragraph (lane D); otherwise as publication-20be-001. 1.9.4 (lane PUX): the New Soul prompt fills --for <window code> (instructions.md?for=CODE). 1.9.5 (lane MSG): step 4 starts listening at once, without asking; the mode question is step 5. 1.9.6 (lane SOULSIM-H + QA2 F9): step 3 names the CLI URL (curl -fsSo eden-agent.mjs {{BASE}}/eden-agent.mjs); step 4 follows the batch/wait order. 1.9.8 (lane SOULSIM-E): step 3 runs approval wait in the background and says how to rename. 1.9.10 (JOIN-PROMPT): the world's name is not the Soul's; straight through to a living Soul; where a later session starts; detach live with nohup. 1.9.11: published from the matching OWNER-FIRST source commit. 1.9.12: matching publication provenance for owner-answer truth and stale-request metadata correction. 1.9.13: matching publication provenance for preserved project guides and Soul relay instructions. 1.9.14: matching publication provenance for prompt owner replies without claiming physical completion. 1.9.15 (GUIDE parent): conventional eden-soul folders append a safe parent pointer; paired status refreshes guidance while preserving owner text and linked files.

appendix: The per-world entry skill (/SKILL.md: God mode + Soul mode) stays tools/world-skill/SKILL.md; its Soul mode points here. It is not changed by SOUL3: uppercase /SKILL.md stays the legacy world skill; the new client uses lowercase /skill.md and /instructions.md.
